about.description:
A comprehensive Python wrapper for the OctoMap C++ library, providing efficient
3D occupancy mapping capabilities for robotics and computer vision applications.
The conda package links against the conda-forge octomap C++ library rather than
bundling a private copy.
about.summary: Python bindings for the OctoMap 3D mapping library.

commands: python -c "import pyoctomap; from pyoctomap import OcTree; t = OcTree(0.1); t.updateNode([1.0, 2.0, 3.0], True); n = t.search([1.0, 2.0, 3.0]); assert n is not None and t.isNodeOccupied(n)"

raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "pyoctomap" %}
{% set version = "1.2.2" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 12385e0e523a96b64e0be11bb05ebabb30cafe37ad8af201f0b9feee4395b2ea

build:
  number: 0
  skip: true  # [py<38]

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ compiler('c') }}
    - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - {{ stdlib('c') }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools
    - cython
    - numpy
    # Reuse the existing conda-forge C++ package instead of vendoring:
    # https://github.com/conda-forge/octomap-feedstock
    - octomap
  run:
    - python

test:
  imports:
    - pyoctomap
  commands:
    - python -c "import pyoctomap; from pyoctomap import OcTree; t = OcTree(0.1); t.updateNode([1.0, 2.0, 3.0], True); n = t.search([1.0, 2.0, 3.0]); assert n is not None and t.isNodeOccupied(n)"

about:
  home: https://github.com/Spinkoo/pyoctomap
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Python bindings for the OctoMap 3D mapping library.
  description: |
    A comprehensive Python wrapper for the OctoMap C++ library, providing efficient
    3D occupancy mapping capabilities for robotics and computer vision applications.
    The conda package links against the conda-forge octomap C++ library rather than
    bundling a private copy.
  dev_url: https://github.com/Spinkoo/pyoctomap
  doc_url: https://github.com/Spinkoo/pyoctomap#readme

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - Spinkoo
